g.text: Objective: diff today's mark against the previous one (for red flags, against the last known one) into the mark events, then weigh the holding for concentration.

text.tspan: the previous mark is read, or there is none
next, event intrinsic_value_crossed_price: decided on the pair of marks
intrinsic value and price are compared
next, event new_red_flag: decided on today's mark and the last known mark
its red flags are compared
next, event below_quality_gate: decided on the pair of marks
its failed gates are compared
next, event sector_recalibrated: decided on the sector weighted average cost of capital (WACC) of the pair of marks, threshold 100 bps
its sector WACC is compared
its weight = market value ÷ total market value, against 15%
its weight in the portfolio is known
next, event concentration: decided on its weight, threshold 15%

g.text: its mark events and concentration are settled
the previous snapshot is read, or there is none

text.tspan: Comes out:
this holding's mark events (zero to five kinds) and its concentration verdict, handed to the snapshot diff

g.text: In practice only growth_reinvestment can fire new_red_flag, or hypergrowth_story for a company with hypergrowth signals and no story file (see analyze flags).
it is neither marked nor weighed [no longer held]
the previous mark is read [it was marked then]
there is no previous mark [first run, or not marked then]

text.tspan: intrinsic value crossed price fires [the gap changed sign]
(intrinsic value − price) < 0 before and > 0 now, or > 0 before and < 0 now; equality is not a cross
no cross [same sign, a zero gap, no previous mark, or a value unknown]
any of the four values unknown: nothing
new red flag fires [red now, not red in the last known mark]
one event per narrative flag red now and not red in the last known mark; no known mark: every red flag is new
no new red flag [none red now, red in the last known mark, or flags unknown]
unknown flags now: nothing
below quality gate fires [a gate fails now that passed before]
one event per gate failing now and not failing before
no new failed gate [none new, no previous mark, or gates unknown]
failed gates unknown on either side: nothing
sector recalibrated fires [the sector WACC moved more than 100 basis points]
|sector WACC now − sector WACC before| > 100 bps
no recalibration [100 basis points or less, no previous mark, or a WACC unknown]
exactly 100 bps: no event; either WACC unknown: nothing
its weight is computed [above 15% of the portfolio]
market value ÷ total market value > 15%
its weight is computed [15% or less, or unpriced]
total over positions with a market value > 0
concentration fires [above 15%]
not a diff: fires on every run while above
no concentration [15% or less]
exactly 15%: no event

g.text: there is no earlier snapshot [first run]
the previous snapshot is read [it held it]
the previous snapshot is read [it did not hold it]
